_doc: Asking about people, places and who there is to marry. ask.person vars: {third} {thirdfull} {thirdaddr} {he} {his} {him} {role} {words} {kinword}; tags third_kin third_stranger third_loved/liked/neutral/disliked/hated third_cleric/noble/common. ask.place vars: {there} {dir} {walk} {kind} {thereLord} {marketday}; tags there_market there_<kind> there_foreign there_strange there_mill. ask.marriageable vars: {names} {first1}.

ask.t: I've heard the name {third}. Who is that?

reply.t: {Thirdfull}? {He} is {role}, as you'd know if you'd lived here a day. {He} is {words}.
{Third} is {role}. I'd call {him} {words}, if you want the plain of it.
Ah, {third}. {Role}, and {words}. That's the measure of {him}.
{Thirdaddr}? Everyone knows {him}. {He} is {words}, and has been since I was small.
{Third} is my own {kinword}. {He} is {words}, and I'll hear no ill said of {him}.
{Third} is my {kinword}, God help me. {He} is {words}.
{Thirdfull} holds this place from the king, or near enough. {He} is {words}, they say.
{Thirdaddr} rules here, and rules, by most accounts, as {words} as lords go.
{Thirdaddr} is {role} — a man of God, though men are men. {He} is {words}.
{Third} watches over our souls, {role}. {He} is {words}, and fair with it.
Oh, {third}! Where to begin? {He} is {words}, they say, and talks the hind leg off a mule.
Of all the people in this place, I'd trust {third} first. {He} is {words}.
Mind {third}. {He} is {words}, and keeps old grudges like some keep hens.
{Third}? I'd cross the road, {addr}. {He} is {words}, which is the kindest I can say.
{Third} is {words}, in my reckoning. But I'm only one voice.
Between you and me, {third} is {words}. Not that I'd say it before others.

feel.t: I'd call {him} a friend, truth be told.
We get along well enough, {third} and I.
I've a soft spot for {him}, I'll admit.
We keep our own counsel, {third} and I.
I'd not seek {him} out, put it that way.
We've had words, {third} and I, more than once.
I can't abide {him}. There. It's said.
There's old bad blood between us. Don't make me tell it.

unknown.t: Never heard of {third}. Not from round here, are they?
{Third}? No. You'd do better to ask elsewhere.
I couldn't say. We don't mix much with folk like that.

ask: What can you tell me of {there}?
I've heard of {there}. Is it worth a visit?

reply.t: {There}? It lies {dir} of here, about {walk}. A {kind}, by all accounts.
Take the road {dir}: {there} is {walk} away. It's a {kind}, of middling size.
{There} is {walk} to the {dir}. I've been once, for a wedding.
Oh, {there}! {Walk} {dir}. A {kind}, as long as you keep your purse close.
A fair {kind} to the {dir}, {walk}. They say the folk there are friendly.
Never been, {addr}. {Walk} {dir} by the road, I'm told. Too far for me.
Past the village? I don't know, {addr}. My legs don't go that far, only my ears. {Walk} {dir}, I think.
I'd have to ask my steward. {There} lies {dir}, about {walk}. A {kind}, as I recall.

more.t: They hold a market there on {marketday}, if you've goods to sell.
Good markets there. Buy low here and sell high there, if you're quick about it.
It belongs to {thereLord}. A fair lord, they say.
There's a mill, and they pay the lord's fee same as we do.
The monks there brew good ale. Or so I'm told.
The nuns are said to be fine weavers. I've never seen it.
A castle, held by {thereLord}. Folk go quiet when they pass it.
A great city, walled and busy. Everything is dearer, and everyone is in a hurry.
Another kingdom, mind. The tolls are different and so are the customs.
They talk oddly there, and keep odd customs. Good folk, though, mostly.

unknown.t: That's a place I've never heard of, {addr}.
I couldn't tell you. I've never left my own parish.

ask: Who is there in these parts a person might marry?
Are there any marriageable folk hereabouts?
I've been thinking of marriage. Who is there?

ask.t: A word between friends: is anyone looking for a match?

reply.t: Let me think... {Names}. Make of that what you will.
There's {names}. Don't tell them I sent you.
Well, I'd put {first1} first on any list. Then: {names}.
Now that's a question. {Names} — those I know of, anyhow.
I know a few: {names}. There'll be more, if you look.
Marriage is a serious matter, {first}. But since you ask: {names}.
A match, eh? You're not the first to ask. {Names}.

none.t: Nobody springs to mind, {addr}. Ask me again when I've thought on it.
None that I'd put forward. Perhaps the next village.
Not that I know of. And I know most.
